draft.title: Values in First Nations Australian literature
card: Literature by First Nations Australian authors can share values that matter to the people and communities it comes from. Three common ones are connection to Country, family and community, and respect for Elders.
Country means the land, waters and sky that a people belong to and care for. A text may show Country as a living part of a person's identity, not just a setting.
A text may show people supported by kin and community, and may show stories being passed down. A character's choices may be shaped by what they owe to others.

Readers also consider the context: who wrote the text, which people or place it comes from, and when it was written. This helps them read the values with care and not assume one text speaks for all First Nations peoples.
draft.remember: These texts can share values such as connection to Country and community, and context helps readers understand them.

a.q: A story shows a girl returning to her grandmother's coastal homeland and feeling the sea and shore are part of who she is. Which value does this show?
opts: Connection to Country
Pride in winning a contest
Wealth as a sign of success
Independence from family
a.why: The girl sees the land and sea as part of her identity, which shows connection to Country. Independence from family is tempting, but she is shown returning to her grandmother's homeland, which points to family ties.
a.clue: Look at how the girl feels about the place.

b.q: Sam reads a poem by a First Nations author and says it shows what all First Nations peoples believe. What should Sam do to read it more carefully?
opts: Think about who wrote it, and where and when it is from
Ignore the author and focus only on the rhyme
Assume its values are the same as in every other text
Decide its values from the title alone
b.why: Context such as the author, community and time helps a reader see where the values come from. One poem does not speak for all First Nations peoples, so assuming it matches every other text is wrong.
b.clue: One text comes from particular people, a place and a time.

b.best: Think about who wrote it, and where and when it is from
